meta.method: Facts are taken only from each issuer's official page (linked per entry) and dated. Third-party articles were used only to choose which certifications to cover. Unstated details are left out, not estimated.

certifications.name: ACCA Qualification
certifications.summary: A professional accountancy qualification that combines exams, ethics and practical experience, leading to ACCA membership.
facts: Combines exams, ethics and three years' professional experience.
Described by ACCA as globally recognised.
Students can earn other qualifications along the way, including a BSc and an MSc.
The ACCA Qualification is changing from 2027.

certifications.name: Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
certifications.summary: An investment analysis credential earned by passing three exams and meeting a work-experience requirement.
facts: Three levels, with one exam at each level.
Recommended study time is 300 hours per level.
Completing all three levels typically takes three to four years.
The charter requires 4,000 hours of relevant work experience over at least 36 months, which can be gained before, during or after the program.
Charterholders must be regular CFA Institute members, with two to three professional references.

certifications.name: Project Management Professional (PMP)
certifications.summary: A project management certification for people who already lead projects.
facts: The exam has 180 questions.
Candidates need 35 hours of project management training.

Eligibility depends on education level (associate's degree or vocational diploma, bachelor's or higher, or a degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center program) and experience leading projects, for example 3+ years.
Holders earn 60 professional development units (PDUs) in each three-year renewal cycle.

certifications.name: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
certifications.summary: A senior cybersecurity certification for professionals who lead an organisation's security programme.
facts: Requires 5 years of work experience.
Covers eight domains, from security and risk management to software development security.
From 15 April 2027 the exam is based on a new exam outline.

certifications.name: CompTIA Security+
certifications.summary: A widely used certification for core cybersecurity skills.
facts: Described by CompTIA as globally recognised.
Version V7 is current; V8 is expected on or around 17 November 2026, adding AI-related risks and security operations.
Typical roles listed: security analyst, security engineer, systems administrator.

certifications.name: Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)
certifications.summary: A networking certification covering network fundamentals, access, IP connectivity, services, security and automation.
facts: One exam: 200-301 CCNA, 120 minutes.
No formal prerequisites; Cisco says it assumes little to no networking knowledge.
Valid for three years.

certifications.name: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
certifications.summary: A foundational certification in AWS Cloud concepts, services and terminology.
facts: 65 questions in 90 minutes.
Exam fee 100 USD (other costs, such as foreign exchange, may apply).
No prior IT or cloud experience required.
Taken at a Pearson VUE test centre or online with a proctor.
Valid for three years.

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals
certifications.summary: A beginner certification in cloud concepts and core Azure services.
facts: Exam AZ-900, 45 minutes, proctored.
Offered in 13 languages, including English, French, Arabic, Spanish and Portuguese (Brazil).
Price depends on the country where the exam is taken.
Scheduled through Pearson VUE, or Certiport for students and educators.

certifications.name: SHRM-CP and SHRM-SCP
certifications.summary: HR certifications for operational (SHRM-CP) and senior strategic (SHRM-SCP) HR professionals.
facts: SHRM-CP: no degree or experience required.
SHRM-SCP: 3+ years in strategic HR, or SHRM-CP held for 3 years.
Computer-based exams at Prometric test centres, in two windows per year.
Recertify every three years through professional development credits or by retaking the exam.
SHRM membership is not required.

certifications.name: CIPD qualifications
certifications.issuer: CIPD (Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development)
certifications.summary: HR and learning-and-development qualifications at foundation, associate and advanced levels.
facts: Offered as foundation, associate and advanced qualifications, or CIPD-accredited university programmes.
Enrolling gives Student Membership; completing a qualification gives Foundation or Associate Membership, with a route to Chartered Membership.
CIPD advises using a legitimate provider, checked with its qualification finder.

certifications.name: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate
certifications.summary: An online beginner programme in data analytics from Google, delivered on Coursera.
facts: A 9-course series.
About 6 months at 10 hours a week.
No degree or experience required.
Completers earn a shareable certificate.
